name: GM-89 Underbarrel Heavy Munition
effect: Attach a grenade launcher to the underbarrel of a Main RIfle or CQB weapon. It may be fired as a Quick Action as a separate weapon, with Loading, Arcing, and 1d6 Explosive Damage with a Blast 1 pattern and Range 10.
description: The GM-89 is simple in concept - a 200mm explosive shell launcher bolted to the underbarrel of a suitable weapon, and slaved to the Mobile Suit's targeting system.

name: Rocket Impulse System
effect: When you successfully Barrage with this weapon, it will deal +2 Kinetic damage and force the target to move 1 space in a direction of your choice. On a critical hit, you may instead force the target to move 3 spaces. If the target strikes Heavy cover, they are immediately knocked Prone.

name: Napalm Shells
effect: When you attack with the modded weapon, you may fire with special napalm ammunition, which turns your weapon’s damage type into Burn until the attack is resolved. Whenever you attack this way, you deal half damage on hit, can’t deal bonus damage, and your weapon is unloaded as if it had the Loading tag. Hit or miss, If the weapon this is applied to attacks in a pattern, the area of effect is covered in lingering flames, causing all characters who end their turn or enter the zone for the first time in a round to take 2 Burn. Characters in this zone additionally automatically fail all Engineering checks to clear Burn. This lingering effect lasts until the end of your next turn.

name: Folding Stock
effect: Reduce this weapon's range by 2. Gain access to the Fold Stock quick action.

actions.name: Fold Stock
actions.detail: The weapon this mod is attached to gains +1 difficulty to all attacks, but benefits from +1 threat range. The stock can be unfolded as another quick action, restoring the weapon's original Threat and accuracy.

name: Pistol Grip
effect: The weapon gains +2 Accuracy, but its base damage profile is reduced solely to damage rolled by dice or Reliable effects. "Flat" damage must be ignored - thus, a weapon with a 1d6+4 damage profile, would become a weapon with a 1d6 damage profile.
description: An optional hilt adjustment for various melee weapons, the pistol grip is an old fashioned type of hilt intended to augment the user's fine control of a blade, at the expense of killing power. Intended for gentlemanly duels, this modification is seldom seen on the battlefield - but a few eccentrics find it familiar and indispensable in duels with enemy mobile suits, when landing the first strike can mean life or death.

added_tags.name: ACCURATE
added_tags.description: Attacks made with this weapon receive +1 Accuracy.

name: 'Bishop' Minovsky Supercharger
effect: Pick one Main or larger weapon without the Overkill tag. That weapon gains Reliable (4) and 1 Heat (Self). If the weapon already has Reliable, it gains +2 Reliable.

added_tags.name: RELIABLE {VAL}
added_tags.description: This weapon has some degree of self-correction or is simply powerful enough to cause damage even with a glancing blow. It always does {VAL} damage, even if it misses its target or rolls less damage. Reliable damage inherits other tags (such as AP) and base damage type but not tags that require a hit, such as Knockback.

added_tags.name: HEAT {VAL} (SELF)
added_tags.description: Immediately after using this weapon or system, the user takes {VAL} Heat.

name: Aural Suppression Suite
effect: This weapon may be used 1/round while Hidden without removing the Hidden status.

name: Twin Barrel
effect: This weapon has been fitted with an additional barrel, augmenting its destructive capabilities in exchange for an overall less stable weapons platform. Thus, upon hitting a target, the weapon deals an additional amount of damage equal to half its "theoretical average" damage. Additionally, the weapon deals 2 Heat to the wielder whenever it is fired.

tags.name: UNIQUE
tags.description: This weapon or system cannot be duplicated – each character can only have one copy of it installed at a time.

name: Radiator Fins
effect: Reduces a weapon's "Heat: Self" value by 1. Additionally, at the end of any turn in which you do not fire this weapon, reduce your Heat by 1.

tags.name: Unique
tags.description: This weapon or system cannot be duplicated – each character can only have one copy of it installed at a time.

name: Shipbreaker Mounting
effect: Disables this mount, but grants use of the Shipbreaker Torpedo. Only one copy of this mod can be applied per mount.

name: Psycommu Control Module
effect: Any weapon that this mod is applied to gains the Drone and Smart tags. This weapon may be fired normally, or deployed into any free space within Sensors as a free action. It may be recalled or redeployed as a Quick Action. While deployed, it may be fired as usual, tracing Range and Line of Sight from itself. If the weapon this is applied to already has the Drone tag, then the weapon additionally gains the Twinned tag.

name: Round Energizer
effect: The weapon this mod is attached to gains Overkill. Whenever this weapon triggers Overkill, it deals +1 Burn damage until the attack resolves.

added_tags.name: Overkill
added_tags.description: When rolling for damage with this weapon, any damage dice that land on a 1 cause the attacker to take 1 Heat, and are then rerolled. Additional 1s continue to trigger this effect.

added_tags.name: Reaction
added_tags.description: This system can be activated as a reaction.

actions.name: Perfect Parry
actions.detail: Counterattack with the modded weapon. On a hit, your rolled damage is subtracted from your enemy’s rolled damage. If you deal more damage, the remainder is dealt to the enemy. If this Reaction results in you not taking any damage, the enemy’s attack is considered to have missed for purposes of traits, systems, and talents.
actions.trigger: An enemy within threat has hit you with a melee attack, and damage has been rolled.

name: “Leech” Grenade Mounting
effect:
Choose a weapon: Attach a grenade launcher that draws on the tool’s internal mechanisms.
1/Round, When you make an attack roll with this weapon, you may choose to miss, then throw a Grenade after the attack resolves with equal range to the range or threat of the modded weapon.

added_tags.name: Unique
added_tags.description: This weapon or system cannot be duplicated – each character can only have one copy of it installed at a time.

tags.name: Unique
tags.description: This weapon or system cannot be duplicated – each character can only have one copy of it installed at a time.

tags.name: Mod
tags.description: This modification can be applied to a weapon. Each weapon can only have one Mod, and cannot have more than one of the same Mod. Mods are applied when the user builds their mech or during a Full Repair.

name: Cable Dagger Module
effect: The applied weapon gains Thrown 5 if it doesn’t already. The weapon also gains the following Quick Action.

added_tags.name: Thrown {VAL}
added_tags.description: This melee weapon can be thrown at targets within {VAL} spaces. Thrown attacks follow the rules for melee attacks but are affected by cover; additionally, a thrown weapon comes to rest in an adjacent space to its target and must be retrieved as a free action while adjacent to that weapon before it can be used again.

actions.name: Spin Up
actions.detail: You start spinning your cabled weapon around, building momentum for a strike. Your next thrown attack with this weapon is made as if the weapon had an additional +3 Thrown. On a hit, the target must roll a Hull save. On a failure, the weapon snags, preventing them or you from moving, voluntarily or involuntarily, away from each other. They may remove the weapon with a successful Hull check taken as a Quick Action–after which the weapon drops into a free adjacent space. This effect also ends if you take the Retrieve action, or are Jammed or Stunned.

actions.name: Retrieve
actions.detail: Use this action to retrieve your thrown weapon if it is still within throwing range. You whip it back to you, striking enemies along the way. Make an attack with this weapon against all characters in a straight line between you and your weapon’s resting point. These attacks deal half damage, burn, and heat on hit, and can not deal bonus damage.

tags.name: Unique
tags.description: This weapon or system cannot be duplicated – each character can only have one copy of it installed at a time.

actions.name: Sheathe
actions.detail: Sheathe the modded weapon. This weapon is loaded into the Gun Sheathe, and becomes unusable in any context other than Draw.

actions.name: Draw
actions.detail: At the start of any turn you have a weapon loaded in the Gun Sheathe, you may use the Draw Quick Action. Attack a target in threat or throwing range of the loaded weapon. On a hit, the attack automatically counts as a critical hit and gains AP. On a miss, the attack deals an amount of Reliable damage equal to the weapon’s minimum damage if the weapon does not already have the Reliable tag. Your weapon is ejected from the sheathe, permitting normal use.

name: Disruptive E-Caps
effect: Choose a weapon that deals energy damage: You load it with unstable Minovsky Particles designed to mess with systems during assaults. It deals half damage but any target hit by it treats all characters within their sensor range as Invisible until the end of their next turn.
description: A modification of the standard E-Cap designed for assaults, the Disruptive E-Caps pack a higher amount of unstable Minovsky particles into the energy charge. The compound disperses on firing, flooding the target with interference, disrupting targeting.

added_tags.name: Mod
added_tags.description: This modification can be applied to a weapon. Each weapon can only have one Mod, and cannot have more than one of the same Mod. Mods are applied when the user builds their mech or during a Full Repair.

added_tags.name: Unique
added_tags.description: This weapon or system cannot be duplicated – each character can only have one copy of it installed at a time.

name: Super Napalm Rocket Launcher
effect: Attach a miniture Rocket Launcher to the underbarrel of a Main RIfle or CQB weapon. It may be fired as a Quick Action as a separate weapon
description: An optional armament mounted underneath the Beam Rifle's barrel, the Super Napalm is a 4-tube rocket launcher that fires powerful napalm rounds. It is used to incinerate large areas.

tags.name: Limited {VAL}
tags.description: This weapon or system can only be used {VAL} times before it requires a Full Repair. Some Limited systems, like Grenades, describe these uses as “charges”. To use the system, the user expends a charge.

actions.name: Super Napalm Rocket
actions.detail:
Upon firing all targets that are hit gain a special burn marker indicating that their source of burn is from minovsky particles. This also effects structures, fortifications, deployables, and dropped items (Equipment, ect.) as they catch on fire and take triple the damage. This can be stacked with other sources of burn damage. All rolls involving engineering gain an additional difficulty.

Anyone starting their turn, or moving into in the burst 2 area must make an engineering save against the Frame's Save Target. A pass results in gaining 1 burn with no special burn marker. A failure results in getting 2 burn with the special burn marker and gaining the shredded status which specifically lasts till the end of your next turn.

name: Ready Rack
effect: 1/Round, as a Protocol, you may expend a charge from this system to load the modified weapon.
description: Strategically placed ready racks allow for much, much quicker loading. Unfortunately, ready racks tend to be extremely limited in ammunition capacity.

tags.description: This weapon or system can only be used {VAL} times before it requires a Full Repair. Some Limited systems, like Grenades, describe these uses as “charges”. To use the system, the user expends a charge.

tags.name: Protocol
tags.description: This system can be activated as a free action, but only at the start of the user’s turn. Another action might be needed to deactivate it.
